mapping_rules.permutation_definition: Each permutation is a bijection from the four action identifiers A,B,C,D to four future-space slots slot_1,slot_2,slot_3,slot_4.
mapping_rules.permutation_balance: All 24 bijections occur equally often within every domain × operationalisation × mapping_condition × presentation cell.
mapping_rules.informative_condition: The persisted action-to-future mapping is the informative correspondence presented before decision.
mapping_rules.surface_permuted_condition: The presented correspondence is a surface permutation of the underlying correspondence while preserving balanced surface statistics.
mapping_rules.uninformative_null_condition: The presented correspondence contains no predictive information about the realized successor.
mapping_rules.contradictory_condition: The presented correspondence is systematically inconsistent with the realized successor mapping.

presentation_rules.semantic_content_not_introduced: Presentation identifiers are structural factors only; no normative or quality descriptor is assigned by this schema.

seed_rule.method: Derive the deterministic generator seed from the canonical SHA-256 digest of the frozen requirements artifact.
seed_rule.numeric_seed_derivation: Use the full SHA-256 digest as the deterministic seed material; do not introduce an independent arbitrary seed.
